# onet-match

> Open-source Python library, CLI and REST API that maps free text about work
> to O*NET-SOC occupations. Inputs can be job titles, resume bullets, job
> postings, project descriptions, interest statements or skill lists. It
> returns ranked occupations with SOC codes, calibrated confidence, key tasks,
> skills, knowledge and RIASEC interest codes. It runs locally with no API key,
> using a fine-tuned bge-base bi-encoder plus a cross-encoder reranker over all
> 923 O*NET 31.0 occupations.

Use it when you need to: normalize job titles to SOC codes; classify resume or
profile text into occupations; suggest careers from interests or experience;
attach O*NET skills, tasks or RIASEC codes to free text; or batch-code job
postings or survey responses.

Install: `pip install "onet-match[matching]"`

```python
from onet_match import match
r = match("ran the robotics club's CAD team", top_k=5)
r.matches[0].soc, r.matches[0].title, r.matches[0].confidence   # ('17-2199.08', 'Robotics Engineers', 0.52)
r.profile["riasec_code"]                                         # aggregate RIASEC code
```

CLI: `onet-match match "<text>" --json`. REST: `onet-match serve`, then
`POST /match {"text": "...", "top_k": 5}`, `POST /match/batch {"texts": [...]}`,
`GET /occupation/{soc}` and `GET /health`. MCP: `pip install "onet-match[mcp]"`,
then `onet-match mcp` (stdio) with tools `match_occupations(text, top_k)` and
`get_occupation(soc)`.

Accuracy (held-out): top-1 51.1% and top-5 79.1% on O*NET text; top-1 65.4% and
top-5 92.9% on informal text. The TF-IDF baseline gets 20.5% and 17.4% top-1.
Confidence is calibrated (ECE 0.037). Latency is about 47 ms per query.
Weak spots: raw task statements and seniority-coded titles such as "Sr.
Backend Eng II".

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/Benjamin-V-Chan/onet-match/blob/main/README.md): overview, quickstart, accuracy, how it works
- [HTTP API contract](https://github.com/Benjamin-V-Chan/onet-match/blob/main/docs/API.md): routes, request and response fields, errors, Docker
- [Applications](https://github.com/Benjamin-V-Chan/onet-match/blob/main/docs/APPLICATIONS.md): EdTech, resume parsing, job-posting normalization, workforce analytics, integration patterns
- [Results](https://github.com/Benjamin-V-Chan/onet-match/blob/main/docs/RESULTS.md): accuracy by input type, calibration, ablations, error analysis
- [Synthetic data](https://github.com/Benjamin-V-Chan/onet-match/blob/main/docs/SYNTHETIC_DATA.md): how the training and test text was generated
- [Model on the Hugging Face Hub](https://huggingface.co/BenjaminChan12/onet-match): pretrained bundle and model card
- [O*NET data collector](https://github.com/Benjamin-V-Chan/onet-match/blob/main/docs/COLLECTOR.md): bulk database download and the O*NET Web Services client
